QuestInfo.name: Love Lost, but not Forgotten
QuestInfo.1: #p2151009# met an another version of you in a different dimension, and was taken to the Temple of Time. The other version of you pointed to a certain place sorrowfully, and disappeared. After returning to this dimension, #p2151009# visited the place he pointed to. You have received what was found there...your precious locket.
QuestInfo.2: #p2151009# found your locket, containing a picture of your family. This picture stirs your heart, and brings back all the emotions you kept buried as one of the Black Mage's terrible commanders. You feel a warm, surging strength in your body... You have rediscovered the power of revenge, locked away in your heart!

0.0: I feel as powerful as I was when I was a commander. The Black Mage will be sorry he chose to betray me.
0.2: I must remember my past. All the sins I've committed.

yes.0: It is my responsibility to ensure that no one will ever feel the pain I have experienced.
yes.1: But I must atone for my sins.

no.0: Forgiveness will only lead to weakness. I must never forget.
